svg.title: ScreenMaster — System Architecture
svg.desc: A browser calls an API gateway that validates a Keycloak JWT and routes to four Spring services — Catalog, Booking, Payment and Notification — each owning its own PostgreSQL database. Booking calls Catalog and Payment reads Booking's payability over REST, while Catalog, Booking and Payment publish events to a RabbitMQ topic exchange that Notification consumes, and Booking confirms a booking off Payment's payment.succeeded event rather than a synchronous call. All services register with Eureka, and Zipkin traces every hop.
svg.text: no gateway edit when an instance scales
